headline: 効かなくなった抗体を、設計し直して復活させた
subhead: etesevimab（CB6）を設計し直し、変異株のRBDとの複合体をクライオ電顕で確かめた

summary.question: 抗体 etesevimab（CB6）は、変異株の出現とともに効かなくなり、オミクロン株には効果を完全に失った。
summary.approach: Rosetta で CB6 の CDR を骨格と配列の両面から設計し、変異を1つずつ SPR で確かめてから組み合わせた。
summary.result: 11 個の変異を入れた CB6-IV は KP.2 を含む試験したオミクロン株の RBD に結合し、擬似ウイルスも中和した。
summary.learned: クライオ電顕構造で CB6-IV は元の CB6 と同じエピトープに結合し、設計した変異の多くが RBD との相互作用を強めていた。
summary.open: BAADesign は結合エネルギーの予測に頼るため、全体に効く変異を見逃すことがある。

question.quote: However, the mAb escaped from the variant of concern (VOC) ever since the emergence of Beta VOC, with a complete loss of efficacy against the Omicron subvariants.

approach.quote: Here, we developed a broad-spectrum and affinity-mature antibody design (BAADesign) procedure to design CB6
we validated each mutation of CB6 step-by-step rather than combining them all at once

result.quote: As expected, CB6-IV exhibited substantially increased binding affinity to all tested RBDs compared to CB6-III, with KD values ranging from 0.36 to 19.07 nM.
the CB6-IV exhibited broad and sensitive neutralizing activity against all tested PT and variant pseudoviruses

learned.quote: suggesting that CB6-IV shares the same epitope with CB6
Taken together, almost all tested mutations in CB6 increased the interaction with the XBB.1.5 RBD and some also contributed to enhanced interaction with the PT RBD.

open.quote: Its sequence design relies on predicting changes in binding energy, which may fail to identify beneficial mutations when the mutated residues influence overall binding rather than local interactions.

highlights.text: 変異で生じる不利を、立体障害と相互作用の低下に分けた。立体障害には、CDR3 の H-Y102 や L-Y92 を欠失させて輪を作り直す骨格設計で対応した。

evidence.quote: Specifically, mutations at N460 (N460K), Q493 (Q493R), and Y505 (Y505H) caused steric hindrance with CB6 heavy chain (H) S56, Y102, and light chain (L) Y92, respectively.
To address the negative effect of steric hindrance, we deleted the residue H-Y102 or L-Y92 in the CB6 CDR3 and remodeled the CDR3 loop using the kinematic closure (KIC) method [34].

highlights.text: PT 型と XBB.1.5 の RBD との複合体は 3.02 Å と 2.49 Å で、CB6-IV は CB6 と同じ面に結合した。H-Y104 は PT RBD の K417 とわずかに衝突し、CB6-III が PT・Delta に弱かった理由を説明する。

evidence.quote: The Cryo-EM structures of the CB6-IV-PT RBD-S309-S304 and CB6-IV-XBB.1.5 RBD-S309-S304 complexes were resolved to 3.0 and 2.5 Å, respectively
Moreover, H-Y104 produces a slight steric clash with PT RBD K417, explaining why CB6-III displayed lower binding affinity to the PT and Delta RBDs than CB6

highlights.text: CB6-IV の CDR1・CDR2 の変異は、同じ結合様式をとる BD-604 や CC12.3 などにも移せた。CC12.3 は XBB・EG.5・BA.2.86 の RBD に結合するようになった。

evidence.quote: Importantly, these mutations enabled CC12.3 to bind to the XBB, EG.5, and BA.2.86 RBDs, and BD-604 to EG.5.
These results suggest that mutations in CB6-IV CDR1 and CDR2 can be shared to help antibodies with the same binding mode increase neutralizing activity against Omicron subvariants.

lab_notes.expression: Fab と RBD は Expi293F 細胞で一過性発現（SPR 用の抗体は HEK293T の上清）。
lab_notes.construct: RBD は spike 残基 319–541。Fab と RBD の C 末端に His タグ。
lab_notes.purification: HisTrap HP のあと、HiLoad 16/600 Superdex 200PG でゲルろ過。
lab_notes.sample_prep: CB6-IV・S309・S304 の Fab と RBD を氷上で一晩混ぜ、ゲルろ過で精製。0.5 mg/mL を Quantifoil Au 1.2/1.3 に載せ 3 秒ブロット。
lab_notes.data_collection: 300 kV Krios と Falcon 4、画素 0.85 Å。CryoSPARC で粒子を選び、最終 205,618 粒子（PT）・282,682 粒子（XBB.1.5）。

evidence.quote: The recombinant RBD and CB6-IV fab plasmids were transiently transfected into Expi293F cells for protein expression, and supernatants were collected 5 days posttransfection.
the SARS-CoV-2 PT RBD (spike residues 319–541, GISAID: EPI_ISL_402119) were cloned into the pCAGGS vector with a C-terminal hexa-histidine (His) tag.
underwent further purification by size-exclusion chromatography using a HiLoad 16/600 Superdex 200PG column
Purified PT RBD or XBB.1.5 RBD proteins were mixed with CB6-IV, S309, and S304 fabs and incubated on ice overnight.
blotted for 3 s at 4 °C and 100% humidity
the grids were transferred to a 300 kV Krios electron microscope equipped with a Falcon 4 using AutoEMation
a final selection of the most homogeneous 205,618 (282,682 for CB6-IV-XBB.1.5 RBD-S309-S304) particles were chosen for 3D auto-refinement

editor_notes: PDB は 8WPY（PT RBD、3.02 Å）と 8WPW（XBB.1.5 RBD、2.49 Å）。複合体を大きくするため非競合の S309・S304 を加えた四者複合体。計算設計の論文だが、設計した抗体の実験構造（クライオ電顕）と SPR・中和試験が主題のため新しい構造として扱った。legend_labels は未設定（render 後に凡例の順を見て書く）。
